Fast and tanky with Giant bosses in the back. ☒☒⌐■-■☒☒|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 28 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Fallen]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Incoming tank zombies!|Beginning of Wave 28 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hazard''' is a quick [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appears in some challenges and the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. While the '''Hazard''' gives off the impression that its immune to certain effects; it is not immune to anything, though it has a defense of 15%. It has 50 health in total and also has 50 shield health. It is slightly faster than the [[Fallen]]. The '''Hazard''' can be spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode, wave 29 onwards. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Hazard''' is an enemy with a desaturated light green skin color. It has a yellow diamond-plated torso and legs, with black and yellow tanks and a breathing apparatus strapped onto its torso. It also has a mask with a black glass visor strapped onto its head. It also has black and yellow armbands on its arms, with the black parts being made of diamond-plating. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The [[Enemies Beta]] version of the '''Hazard''' has a light green skin color, as well as a black torso, arms and legs. It wears a yellow and black hazmat suit, which consists of shoulder-pads, a vest, gas tanks, shoes and a helmet with a grey screen. }} ==Strategy== *Splash damage towers, like the [[Demoman]], [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]], are recommended against the '''Hazard''' since they mostly spawn in groups, Additionally, splash damage ignores its defense, dealing full damage. **Other towers that can hit multiple enemies, like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Executioner]] can also be used. *Towers with decent DPS, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]] and [[Accelerator]], will certainly help against '''Hazards'''. *Slowing towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] or [[Sledger]] can be quite useful against this. **Due to its average size and lack of immunities, these towers can easily stop a horde of '''Hazards''' in its track. *Towers that drop defense, such as the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Freezer]], can be effective against the '''Hazard''', allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. **This is not required however, as the '''Hazard''' has negligible defense and low health. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} HazardPreOverhaul.png|First version, first animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseHazard.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} April Fools 2022 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Hazard''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''Hazard''' in the game trailer. Tower Defense Simulator- 🌵 BADLANDS Trailer! 🌵|'''Hazard''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} HazardIconIG.png|'''Hazard''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Hazard''' was likely inspired by the [[w:c:r2da:Ticker|Ticker]] from ''R2DA''. *Despite hazmat suits being known to be flame-retardant, the '''Hazard''' is not immune to poison or fire. *There is a skin series that has a similar appearance to the current appearance of the '''Hazard''', namely the {{Color|Premium|Hazmat}} from the [[Premium Crate]]. *The mask that the '''Hazard''' wears is the {{RLinkC|16725421|Fire Fighter Hazard Mask}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. **The mask that the [[Enemies Beta]] '''Hazard''' wears is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|17981876|Hazmat Isolation Helmet}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The [[Enemies Beta]] '''Hazard''' uses a slightly altered version of the [[Hazardous]]'s model. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' -
